description: This is a minimalist floor lamp featuring two spherical light sources. Each light source is a white globe, set on a slender, curved arm. The two arms connect to a single, vertical, cylindrical base. The overall design is very sleek and modern, characterized by smooth surfaces and simple geometric shapes, predominantly in white with subtle grey shading that gives it a refined, architectural quality. The lamp is designed to provide ambient lighting while also serving as a contemporary decorative element.
